subject: Fix build warnings with OpenSSL 4.0 (#4016)
reason: The change is a build-warning fix in src/tls.c for OpenSSL 4.0 API deprecations. The new isCertValid logic is compiled only under OPENSSL_VERSION_NUMBER >= 0x40000000L, so on the CI build (OpenSSL < 4.0) that code is dead and behavior is identical to the parent. The getCertSubjectFieldByName rewrite is a semantics-preserving replacement of the deprecated X509_NAME_get_text_by_NID, reachable only during TLS client-certificate ACL authentication. The fuzzer cannot reach any TLS path: tls-port is a provider-owned option rejected in every server_config, no component provisions certificates or open
